verdict.rationale: Trello's own site says it offers easy-to-use templates from industry leaders and the Trello community to give teams a blueprint, which directly covers starting a new project from pre-built templates. The evidence is a single marketing line with no detail on how templates are applied or what they contain. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the template gallery and how to create a board from a template, evidence of product-management-specific templates, independent or hands-on corroboration of using templates to start a project.
